The '''''Acushnet''''' was a [[Corona-class armed frigate/Legends|''Corona''-class armed frigate]], a ship derived from an ancient [[Surronian cruiser]] design, used by a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|gang]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]].<ref name="DC" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Acushnet_on_Felucia.png|thumb|left|220px|''Acushnet'' on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]]]
The vessel was made by [[Haor Chall Engineering/Legends|Haor Chall Engineering]]. It had room enough for six [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class Weequay ships]], which could be launched from the center of its ventral superstructure.<ref name="DC" />

The craft was capable of landing on planetary surfaces and had eight landing legs. The eighth doubled as a boarding ramp.<ref name="DC" />

==History==
[[File:CrucibleAttacked-BFR.png|thumb|left|250px|''Acushnet'' firing on the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]] [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']]]]
The pirate band of [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] used this armed frigate to carry out their raids in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. Ohnaka obtained the ship by confiscating it and several [[Flarestar-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Flarestar''-class Weequay ships]] from a starship collector in [[Farana (region)/Legends|Farana]]. The vessel was worth many [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to collectors, but Hondo refused to sell the ship.<ref name="VGUB">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Visual Guide: Ultimate Battles]]''</ref>

The ship and its crew landed on [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]] during [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] [[Skirmish at Vanqor/Legends|hunt]] for [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] scavenged the Count's [[Punworcca 116-class interstellar sloop/Legends|''Punworcca 116''-class interstellar sloop]]. Ohnaka offered Dooku passage to Florrum. He accepted the offer and traveled with them in the ship to their home on Florrum. In actuality, the pirates held Dooku hostage.<ref name="DC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ship was originally identified as a Surronian cruiser in the ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Visual Guide Ultimate Battles'' guidebook,<ref name="VGUB" /> but was later identified in ''Galaxy at War'' as a ''Corona''-class armed frigate. The crosssections book ''Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles'' later rectified this by stating that the ship's specific class was the ''Corona''-class armed frigate, and that the ship class was in fact derived from an ancient design belonging to the Surronian cruiser.
